Name: Libni, Son of Gershom
Summary: Son of Gershom, named among the sons of Gershom.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:17: Son of Gershom, named among the sons of Gershom.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Libni stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
